lines:
| SVG logo morph between two shapes | GSAP MorphSVG — read `.agents/skills/gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md` |
| Line drawing / stroke reveal on SVG | GSAP DrawSVG — read `.agents/skills/gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md` |
| Object following a curved path | GSAP MotionPath — read `.agents/skills/gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md` |
| Per-character / per-word title reveals | GSAP SplitText — read `.agents/skills/gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md` |
| Custom bezier or elastic easing | GSAP CustomEase — read `.agents/skills/gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md` |
| Layout-to-layout element flight (FLIP) | GSAP Flip — read `.agents/skills/gsap-plugins/SKILL.reference.md` |
| Multi-step sequence across many elements | GSAP timeline — read `.agents/skills/gsap-timeline/SKILL.reference.md` |

**Remotion determinism rule:** every GSAP use inside a Remotion component must drive timeline progress from `useCurrentFrame()` — never `requestAnimationFrame`. Pattern examples in `.agents/skills/gsap-react/SKILL.reference.md`.
